subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad Anthropic signed-thinking replay umbrella remain open until all variants are resolved, or should maintainers hand off the remaining prevention work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its focused PR?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are already on main, but the remaining prevention path intentionally changes provider replay policy for thinking-enabled Anthropic histories and overlaps multiple open candidate PRs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 after posting a clear handoff to the focused prevention PRs.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the landed recovery fixes as sufficient for now and leave prevention replay-policy changes for a later provider review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: He is already in the issue discussion and has recent area history around Fable/adaptive thinking and the affected Anthropic provider boundary.
